The OFF-by-default Chuseok Galbwae style offers mutually exclusive all-text and dialogue-plus-bold-Markdown scopes, suppresses every other optional style prompt while active, preserves internal repair data through the custom-translator path, detects Latin character names in Korean-particle, Markdown, tag-only, vocative, repeated, possessive and nearby-Korean contexts even when dormant bilingual settings exist, and preserves Info_panel, numbers and protected structure.
Paired-tag natural-language translation defaults ON; OFF preserves tag structure and inner text while translating outside text. Nested and tag-only cases pass.

All nine built-in English guidance fields are visible, unedited fields keep the original dynamic prompt path, edited fields activate replacement, legacy custom text is preserved, and unedited defaults automatically refresh to the newest bundled text.
Complete settings markup, unique IDs, visibility controls, engine selector, tagged-content toggle placement, compact inner UI and v0.6.10 metadata pass.

The opt-in delayed profile race starts later profiles after the saved 5-180 second user delay (35 seconds by default), or immediately on transient failures; it uses the first valid response, aborts losing requests, enforces the saved overall timeout and per-profile failure timeout, preserves user cancellation, and exposes compact timing inputs.

Normal and minimal-output translation paths return the first complete model result after local deterministic cleanup; banned-word, untranslated-text, protected-token, Latin-name and quality-audit AI repair code and prompts remain available behind one shared switch. Malformed or incomplete JSON gets at most one missing-segment recovery request.
